{{verse|chapter=1|verse=1|align=float}}{{dropinitial|P}}{{sc|Avl}} and Timothee the {{ls}}eruants of {{sc|Iesvs}} Chri{{ls}}t: to al the {{ls}}ainctes in Chri{{ls}}t {{sc|Iesvs}} that are at Philippi, vvith the {{sup|‖}} Bi{{ls}}hops and Deacons. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=2|align=float}}† Grace to you and peace from God our father, and our Lord {{sc|Iesvs}} Chri{{ls}}t. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=3|align=float}}† I giue thankes to my God in al memorie of you {{verse|chapter=1|verse=4|align=float}}† (alvvaies in al my praiers for al you, vvith ioy making petition) {{verse|chapter=1|verse=5|align=float}}† for your communicating in the Go{{ls}}pel of Chri{{ls}}t from the fir{{ls}}t day vntil novv. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=6|align=float}}† {{outside L|The Epi{{ls}}tle vpon the 22 Sunday after Penteco{{ls}}t.}}tru{{ls}}ting this {{ls}}ame thing, that he vvhich hath begōne in you a good vvorke, vvil perfit it vnto the day of Chri{{ls}}t {{sc|Iesvs}}. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=7|align=float}}† as it is rea{{ls}}on for me, this to thinke for al you, for that I haue you in hart, & in my bandes, and in the defen{{ls}}e, and the confirmation of the Go{{ls}}pel, al you to be partakers of my ioy. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=8|align=float}}† For God is my vvitnes, hovv I couet you al in the bovvels of {{sc|Iesvs}} Chri{{ls}}t. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=9|align=float}}† And this I pray, that your charitie may more and more abound in knovvledge and in al vnder{{ls}}tanding: {{verse|chapter=1|verse=10|align=float}}† that you may approue the better things, that you may be {{ls}}incere and vvithout offence vnto the day of Chri{{ls}}t, {{verse|chapter=1|verse=11|align=float}}† repleni{{ls}}hed vvith the fruite of iu{{ls}}tice by {{sc|Iesvs}} Chri{{ls}}t, vnto the glorie and prai{{ls}}e of God.⊣
